label: v4.0.0.1 claims every prompt carries its skill suggestion, but at HEAD the Pi extension suppresses the whole advisor contribution (route line plus Directives block) on a proven same-content repeat; only first turn, changed contribution, resume/compact, unknown sessions and the SPECKIT_PI_DIRECTIVE_DEDUP kill-switch (default enabled) fail open, and nothing on screen or in the [advisor-debug] line marks a suppression as such.

v4.0.0.9's 'every mode alias is lowercase and listed among its router keywords' has no field to be true about: mode-registry.json modes carry workflowMode plus an aliases array of multi-word trigger phrases, and a 7-hub read-only check of those two fields finds 411 violating values out of 518; no mode object in any hub has an alias, id, mode or name key, so a checker written from the release note inspects zero values and prints a vacuous PASS (aliasesChecked=0 violations=0).

OpenCode's surface hint goes through detectWorkspaceSurface, which memoizes into workspaceSurfaceCache on read and write with no invalidation in the function, so a user who adds or removes a surface mid-session (the v4.0.0.10 adapting workflow) keeps a stale hint until the plugin process restarts and is told nothing about needing one.
A release claim stated over a registry field is only verifiable if that field exists; where it does not, any checker written from the claim passes vacuously and a green result carries no information.
